description: Tool to update an existing product in Stripe. Use when you need to modify product details like name, description, pricing, or availability.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for updating an existing product in Stripe.

active.description: Whether the product is available for purchase. Set to false to archive.
active.title: Active

default_price.description: The ID of the Price object that is the default price for this product.
default_price.title: Default Price

description.description: The product's description, meant to be displayable to the customer. Use this field to optionally store a long form explanation of the product being sold for your own rendering purposes.
description.title: Description

id.description: The unique identifier of the product to update.
id.title: Id

images.description: A list of up to 8 URLs of images for this product, meant to be displayable to the customer.
images.title: Images

marketing_features.description: A list of up to 15 marketing features for this product. These are displayed in pricing tables.

items.description: Represents a marketing feature to be displayed on pricing tables.

name.description: Name of the marketing feature (max 80 characters).
name.title: Name

items.title: MarketingFeature

marketing_features.title: Marketing Features

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to metadata.
metadata.title: Metadata

name.description: The product's name, meant to be displayable to the customer.
name.title: Name

package_dimensions.description: The dimensions of the product for shipping purposes.

height.description: Package height in inches (max 2 decimal places).
height.title: Height

length.description: Package length in inches (max 2 decimal places).
length.title: Length

weight.description: Package weight in ounces (max 2 decimal places).
weight.title: Weight

width.description: Package width in inches (max 2 decimal places).
width.title: Width

package_dimensions.title: PackageDimensions

shippable.description: Whether this product is shipped (i.e., physical goods).
shippable.title: Shippable

statement_descriptor.description: An arbitrary string to be displayed on your customer's credit card or bank statement. While most banks display this information consistently, some may display it incorrectly or not at all. This may be up to 22 characters.
statement_descriptor.title: Statement Descriptor

tax_code.description: A tax code ID for determining tax rates on sales of this product.
tax_code.title: Tax Code

unit_label.description: A label that represents units of this product. When set, this will be included in customers' receipts, invoices, Checkout, and the customer portal. Use singular form. Up to 12 characters.
unit_label.title: Unit Label

url.description: A URL of a publicly-accessible webpage for this product.
url.title: Url
